description: Return identity, evidence counts, outcome groups and top findings for 2 to 5 peptides, plus shared outcome groups. Use this for a comparison in one call. Use get_peptide_brief instead for a detailed summary of one peptide. The result compares evidence without ranking peptides as better or worse. Each finding has an evidence class: human, animal, laboratory or predicted. A count of 0 human findings means no checked human findings within the filters or outcome group. It does not mean that no human study exists. Each MCP column includes the largest 8 outcome groups, or 5 for 4 or 5 peptides. Each column includes 2 top findings for 2 or 3 peptides, or 1 for 4 or 5 peptides. Use get_evidence_map for all outcome groups or search_findings for more findings.

anyOf.description: Peptide name, alias, slug or ID. Examples: BPC-157, semaglutide, PEP-000001.
